$comment: Frozen adapter from protocol schema 1.x (euler-eval <= 2.47) to the v2 contract. docs/contract.md section 10. Never edit in place: a change is a new table version.

image_mean.label: image mean
image_mean.description: Arithmetic mean of the per-image values.

pixel_pool.label: pixel pool
pixel_pool.description: Pixel pool of a v1 file: v1 records no per-item weights, so it cannot be recomputed.

reference.gt.label: GT
reference.gt.description: The ground truth the prediction is scored against.

reference.calibration.label: calibration
reference.calibration.description: Camera calibration the evaluation reads (intrinsics for normals, radial/planar depth conversion).

reference.segmentation.label: GT segmentation
reference.segmentation.description: GT semantic segmentation; read for GT sky masking and sky IoU only.

reference.intrinsics.label: intrinsics
reference.intrinsics.description: Per-frame camera intrinsics (sparse lidar projection, point maps).

reference.camera_extrinsics.label: camera extrinsics
reference.camera_extrinsics.description: Camera poses used to project sparse GT.

reference.lidar_extrinsics.label: lidar extrinsics
reference.lidar_extrinsics.description: Lidar-to-camera transforms used to project sparse GT.

reference.input.label: input image
reference.input.description: The (degraded) RGB input the prediction restores; the reference of input-referenced metrics.

reference.depth.label: GT depth
reference.depth.description: GT depth an RGB evaluation reads for its depth-binned metrics.

sky.gt.masking.label: GT sky masking
sky.gt.masking.description: Pixels labelled sky in the GT segmentation are left out of every metric (--mask-sky).

sky.gt.missing_policy.label: frames without segmentation
sky.gt.missing_policy.description: What happens to frames without their own GT segmentation under GT sky masking: drop (left out) or unmasked (scored without masking).

sky.pred.masking.label: predicted-sky masking
sky.pred.masking.description: Pixels in the prediction's own sky mask are left out of every metric (--mask-sky-prediction).

sky.pred.fill.label: predicted-sky fill
sky.pred.fill.description: Whether the prediction's sky mask was loaded and used (filled at the depth cap, or excluded under predicted-sky masking).

domain.grid.label: evaluated grid
domain.grid.description: [height, width] of the grid the metrics were computed on.

prediction.resample.label: prediction resampled
prediction.resample.description: Factor [height, width] by which the prediction was resampled onto the evaluated grid (target / source); [1, 1] when it was not.

spatial.gt_resample.label: GT resampled
spatial.gt_resample.description: Factor [height, width] by which the GT was resampled onto the prediction grid (target / source); [1, 1] when it was not. Resampled GT is different GT.

spatial.method.label: spatial alignment
spatial.method.description: How prediction and GT resolutions were reconciled (none, crop, vae_crop, resize_prediction, resize, warp_prediction, warp, pointcloud_projection). Compared through the keys it is derived from.

spatial.resize_target.label: resize target
spatial.resize_target.description: Which grid is resampled when resolutions differ and the prediction is not a crop: gt_grid (prediction onto GT) or prediction_grid (GT onto prediction).

spatial.mask_resample.label: mask resampling
spatial.mask_resample.description: Interpolation used to resample masks (nearest, nearest_exact).

depth.benchmark.range_m.label: benchmark depth range
depth.benchmark.range_m.description: [min, max] GT depth of the benchmark bins; compared through the stratification it defines.

depth.alignment.mode.label: depth alignment mode
depth.alignment.mode.description: Configured alignment mode (none, auto_affine, affine); whether a fit ran is depth.alignment.applied.

depth.alignment.applied.label: depth alignment applied
depth.alignment.applied.hint: compare the native space, or two fitted runs
depth.alignment.applied.description: Whether a scale/shift fit to the GT produced the metric space.

depth.cap.max_m.label: depth cap
depth.cap.max_m.description: Predictions (and filled predicted sky) are clipped at this depth; inert when nothing was clipped.

depth.invalid.policy.label: invalid-value policy
depth.invalid.policy.description: How declared invalid sentinels are treated: exclude_sentinel (not scored) or score_sentinel.

rgb.fid.backend.label: FID backend
rgb.fid.backend.description: Inception feature backend of FID/KID (builtin, clean-fid).

rgb.input.alignment.label: input alignment
rgb.input.alignment.description: How the input was put on the prediction grid (none, crop_input, upscale_input, upscale_prediction, warp_input).

rgb.input.alignment_policy.label: input alignment policy
rgb.input.alignment_policy.description: Rule choosing the input alignment: upscale (always upscale the smaller side) or follow_gt (crop when the prediction is a crop).

rgb.depth_bins.policy.label: depth-bin policy
rgb.depth_bins.policy.description: Revision of how GT depth is put on the RGB grid for depth-binned photometric metrics (v1, v2).

rays.fov_policy.label: FoV policy
rays.fov_policy.description: Revision of how the FoV domain (sfov, lfov, pano) and its ρ_A threshold are chosen (v1, v2).

points3d.alignment.mode.label: point-map alignment mode
points3d.alignment.mode.description: Configured gauge alignment (none, scale, similarity, auto).

points3d.alignment.applied.label: point-map alignment applied
points3d.alignment.applied.hint: compare the native space, or two aligned runs
points3d.alignment.applied.description: Whether a gauge alignment produced the metric space (auto that resolved to none counts as not applied).

legacy.metrics_revision.label: metrics revision
legacy.metrics_revision.description: A v1 method.metrics_revision newer than this table knows; compared strictly.
